It sets up routes, reads path, query and body parameters, coerces types (String(), typeof checks, new Date(dueDate)), checks that required request fields are present, calls the application use cases and turns results and errors into HTTP status codes and JSON. All of this is transport or presentation adapter work, which belongs in infrastructure. The constructor builds the use cases from the injected repository ports. That is composition and wiring, which is also an infrastructure job. The file contains no business rules: decisions about task state, assignment eligibility and project existence are handed to the use cases.
